summary.text: Anitra Hamilton is a Democratic member of the West Virginia House of Delegates, representing District 81, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was appointed to the seat by Governor Jim Justice in 2023 and works in health care.

paragraphs.text: Anitra Hamilton graduated from Mount View High School and earned bachelor's degrees from West Virginia University in psychology in 2000, biology in 2001 and nursing in 2004.
Her career experience includes working in health care.
She has served as president of the NAACP for Morgantown and Kingwood, as vice president of the WVU Council on Gender Equity, and as minister of Agape Life in Fairmont.
Governor Jim Justice appointed Hamilton to the House of Delegates on April 26, 2023, to replace Danielle Walker, and she assumed office on May 5, 2023.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on May 12, 2026.
